column1: # The eleven baselines of the post-trained 0.6B student. Tab-separated; read with: column -t -s$'\t' RUN_MATRIX.tsv
# a100_h = wall clock we measured for the SAME method on the 0.6B-Base student, 4x A100-80GB (2 actor + 2 teacher).
# l40s_h = expected wall clock on one 3-GPU L40S slot (2 actor + 1 teacher). Planning range, not a promise.
# offline = trajectory file that must exist before training starts (scripts/02_offline_data.sh).
# Offline data generation: teacher trajectories ~3.2 h on 4 A100 (~10 h on a 3-GPU slot);
# TRD trajectories ~6.1 h on 4 A100 (~20 h on a 3-GPU slot).
# All eleven with two slots in parallel: roughly 12-17 days. The first six rows alone: roughly 4-5 days.
